content: Animated background pitfalls: reduced text contrast/readability if opacity/color untuned; failing prefers-reduced-motion or lacking pause/disable controls harms vestibular/photosensitive users; broken keyboard focus/screen-reader flow if animation traps focus; unoptimized canvas/WebGL tanking frame rate below 60fps and hurting load on low-power devices. Mitigations: low opacity, prefers-reduced-motion + static fallback, explicit pause control, device-tier detection, DevTools profiling.
